task: List the benefits of hugging face classroom mentioned on Hugging face website.
answer:
Benefits of Hugging Face Classroom mentioned on the Hugging Face website (https://huggingface.co/classrooms):
1. Bring state-of-the-art tools to your Classrooms, for Free - Hugging Face for Classrooms provides free resources, teaching materials and support for students and teachers.
2. Empower your students with state-of-the-art resources - Implement machine learning with Hugging Face tools and collaborate with your students easily on all their datasets, models and ML demos hosted within your classroom workspace.
3. Give your students unlimited access to modern machine learning tools - Upload datasets, models and demos for free. Train, fine-tune, experiment and deploy, then share models and demos with the classroom or community, all hosted for free.
4. Easily manage your classroom - Centralize students' datasets, models and demos in one place, collaborate with version control and student access controls (admin, read, write), then share privately or publicly with the community.
